diff --git a/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/CMakeLists.txt b/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/CMakeLists.txt
index 5b8ba54..6c377e0 100644
--- a/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -25,6 +25,41 @@ add_compile_definitions(__PRIVATE_DEBUG__)
 add_compile_definitions(__PRIVATE_BUILD__)
 add_compile_definitions(__DEBUG__)
 
+# __DEBUG__ is defined unconditionally above and gates many unrelated debug
+# behaviours, so it must NOT be used to decide whether an operator may continue
+# past unresolved SDK mappings. That is a separate, explicit decision:
+#   cmake -DSOLSTICE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS=ON ...
+# Default OFF means EVERY configuration (including Release) refuses to start
+# with a broken mapping table; the initialization report is still written.
+option(SOLSTICE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS
+       "Allow an operator to continue with unresolved SDK mappings (diagnostics only)" OFF)
+if (SOLSTICE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS)
+    add_compile_definitions(SOLSTICE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS)
+endif ()
+
+# Diagnostic-only build option. When ON, the Aura module is never constructed or
+# registered, so its entire execution path (constructor, onEnable/onDisable/onTick,
+# event and packet listeners registered through the shared dispatcher) is absent
+# from the running process. Used to test whether Aura is the cause of a startup
+# hang regression. Default OFF keeps the released binary identical; every other
+# module, the shared SDK, and the global DEBUG override are untouched.
+option(SOLSTICE_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC
+       "Build without the Aura module to isolate a suspected hang regression (diagnostics only)" OFF)
+if (SOLSTICE_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC)
+    add_compile_definitions(SOLSTICE_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC)
+endif ()
+
+# 3.6.2-F: subscriber-level RenderEvent fault localization. When ON, the GL HUD
+# dispatch is instrumented with per-subscriber BEGIN/END markers written to a
+# dedicated flush-on-write diagnostic file (solstice_render_diag.log). The
+# production dispatch path is compiled out entirely when this is OFF, so the
+# released binary is identical. Default OFF.
+option(SOLSTICE_RENDER_DIAG
+       "Instrument RenderEvent dispatch with per-subscriber BEGIN/END diagnostics (3.6.2-F fault localization)" OFF)
+if (SOLSTICE_RENDER_DIAG)
+    add_compile_definitions(SOLSTICE_RENDER_DIAG)
+endif ()
+
 find_program(LD_COMMAND ld)
 
 if (NOT LD_COMMAND)
@@ -169,8 +204,14 @@ find_package(OpenMP)
 # ALL: this must run on every build, not only when it is requested explicitly.
 # Without it a build directory that was configured earlier keeps the commit hash
 # from that moment, and the log then reports a version the binary is not.
+# 3.6.2-E: also forward the build configuration and the two diagnostic CMake
+# options so a crash log can show exactly how the binary was built.
 add_custom_target(generate_build_info ALL
-        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
+        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
+            -DSOLSTICE_CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$<CONFIG>
+            -DSOLSTICE_OPT_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED=${SOLSTICE_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS}
+            -DSOLSTICE_OPT_DISABLE_AURA=${SOLSTICE_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC}
+            -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
         COMMENT "Generating build info [${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/build_info.h]"
 )
 
@@ -282,7 +323,15 @@ endforeach()
 add_resources(resource_files ${resource_files})
 
 add_library(Solstice SHARED ${sourceFiles} ${resource_files})
-add_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} generate_build_info SolsticeShaders)
+add_dependencies(Solstice generate_build_info SolsticeShaders)
+# 3.6.2-E.1 (P1-1): make the build-info ordering explicit and target-scoped.
+# `Solstice` is the translation unit that `#include <build_info.h>`, so it must
+# never compile before `generate_build_info` has (re)written that header. The
+# custom target runs on EVERY build (it is ALL), but without this edge CMake is
+# free to schedule the Solstice compile first on a clean tree, leaving the
+# compiler staring at a stale or missing build_info.h. This edge forces the
+# generator to finish before any Solstice object is compiled.
+add_dependencies(Solstice generate_build_info)
 
 set(RESOURCE_HEADER_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Utils/Resources.hpp")
 set(RESOURCE_SOURCE_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Utils/Resources.cpp")

diff --git a/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake b/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
index e144bf5..eb08b24 100644
--- a/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
+++ b/solstice/solstice-src/solstice-master-main/solstice-master-main/GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
@@ -72,6 +72,18 @@ message(STATUS "Build branch: ${SOLSTICE_BUILD_BRANCH}")
 string(TIMESTAMP SOLSTICE_BUILD_TIMESTAMP "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" UTC)
 file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_TIMESTAMP \"${SOLSTICE_BUILD_TIMESTAMP}\"\n")
 
+# 3.6.2-E.1 (P1-1): SOURCE FINGERPRINT HASH SCOPE -- explicit.
+# The fingerprint is derived ONLY from the C++ source tree under src/:
+#   src/*.cpp, src/*.hpp, src/*.h   (GLOB_RECURSE, case-sensitive, sorted)
+# Algorithm:
+#   1. for every matched file: SHA256(file) -> keep first 16 hex chars
+#   2. concatenate those 16-char digests in sorted file order -> one string
+#   3. SHA256(that string) -> keep first 12 hex chars = SOLSTICE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT
+# It does NOT include: CMake files, generated build_info.h, assets, headers
+# outside src/, or any runtime/working-tree state. So a matching fingerprint
+# pins the *compiled source content* regardless of git commit, branch, or
+# whether the tree was dirty -- which is exactly why it survived the 73da588
+# provenance check even though that build's commit/branch metadata lagged.
 file(GLOB_RECURSE SOLSTICE_SOURCE_FILES
         "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/*.cpp"
         "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/*.hpp"
@@ -156,6 +168,43 @@ endif()
 
 file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_INTENDED_VERSION \"${SOLSTICE_INTENDED_VERSION}\"\n")
 
+# --- Build identity completeness (3.6.2-E) ---------------------------------
+# These fields let a crash log show exactly how the binary was built, without
+# re-deriving it from the running process. They do NOT change
+# SOLSTICE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINT (that only hashes src/*.cpp/*.hpp/*.h); they only
+# record the build's configuration. All are backward-compatible: if GenerateBuildInfo.cmake
+# is run directly (no -D forwards) the option variables are undefined and skipped.
+if (DEFINED SOLSTICE_CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT SOLSTICE_CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "")
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_CONFIG \"${SOLSTICE_CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}\"\n")
+else()
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_CONFIG \"unknown\"\n")
+endif()
+# 3.6.2-E.1 (P1-1): record BOTH diagnostic options on every build, explicitly
+# as 0 or 1. Previously only the enabled state was emitted via #ifdef, so a
+# crash log could not tell "option was OFF" apart from "build_info.h predates
+# this field". Now OFF and undefined both land as 0, which is accurate.
+if (SOLSTICE_OPT_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED)
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS 1\n")
+else()
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_MAPPINGS 0\n")
+endif()
+if (SOLSTICE_OPT_DISABLE_AURA)
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC 1\n")
+else()
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_BUILD_DISABLE_AURA_DIAGNOSTIC 0\n")
+endif()
+execute_process(COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} status --porcelain
+        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}"
+        OUTPUT_VARIABLE _solstice_git_status OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE ERROR_QUIET)
+# 3.6.2-E.1 (P1-1): renamed SOURCE_DIRTY -> WORKTREE_DIRTY to avoid implying the
+# fingerprint (which is content-derived) can be dirty. This only reflects
+# `git status --porcelain` on the working tree, i.e. uncommitted edits.
+if (NOT _solstice_git_status STREQUAL "")
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_WORKTREE_DIRTY 1\n")
+else()
+    file(APPEND "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "#define SOLSTICE_WORKTREE_DIRTY 0\n")
+endif()
+
 execute_process(
         COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E compare_files "${TEMP_BUILD_INFO_PATH}" "${BUILD_INFO_PATH}"
         RESULT_VARIABLE FILES_DIFFER

-/// <summary>

-///

-/// the hash table. Actor::getNameTag therefore validates whatever it reads here
-/// before using it, and prints the bytes once when they do not read as a string.
-/// </summary>
-class NameableComponent

-public:
